summary: Complete pending publication autonomously and protect frozen goal config

delivery.outcome: Governed pull-request mode completes a waited-for publication on a clean synchronized base (publish-completion event, publishing re-enabled, clean publish-only release machinery) instead of a no-change return; config auto-detection skips tooling caches and governed runtime state, never replaces an explicit versioning.files projection, and governed targets load the frozen goal.yaml without rewrites from every command.
nonGoals: No changes to the protected gate contracts or delivery policy schema
No changes to publishing transports or registry credentials handling

architecture.decision: Reinterpret the governed no-change boundary as a publish completion when committed unreleased sources exist (mirroring the legacy continuation); make config auto-detection bootstrap-only for versioning.files and cache-safe; extend the governed load_config protection to every command.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of the three source files; no data migration.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_push_workflow_completion.py -k 'discovery or preserves_explicit or never_rewrites'
